text:

ORDER SHEET.

JUDICIAL DEPARTMENT.

The State 
 
S. No. of 
order/ 
proceedings 
Date of  
order/ 
Proceedings 
Order with signature of Judge and that of parties 
or counsel where necessary.  
05.01.2026
Mr. Basit Mehmood Abbasi, Advocate for the 
petitioner alongwith the petitioner.   
 
 
 
Through the instant petition, the petitioner 
Inayat ur Rehman s/o Wazir Zada, seeks protective 
bail in a case F.I.R No. 302/2021, dated 13.07.2021, 
offence under Section 365 P.P.C., registered with 
Police Station Saddar, District Gujrat, Punjab. 
 
2. 
It is contended by learned counsel for the 
petitioner that on account of imminent threat of 
arrest, the petitioner is not able to approach the 
Court of first instance and, therefore, he may be 
granted protective bail.  
 
 
3. 
The accused namely Inayat ur Rehman is 
granted ad-interim transitory bail for seven (07) 
days. Accused is directed to approach the Court of 
competent jurisdiction on or before 12.01.2026. 
Instant bail granting order shall cease to exist and 
expire automatically after the Court hours of 
referred date i.e. 12.01.2026. 
 
4. 
The instant petition stands disposed of in the 
above terms.   
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
          (MUHAMMAD ASIF)      
                      JUDGE                        
Ahmed Sheikh
